title: Major disaster declaration DR-4932-WV: Flood
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4932-WV, "SEVERE STORM, STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS, TORNADOES, FLOODING, LANDSLIDES, AND MUDSLIDES") for WV, dated 2026-08-03, for an incident of type "Flood". The incident period began on 2026-07-21 and ended on 2026-07-22. The declaration lists 11 designated areas.
